name: hydrogen peroxide
uses: Use Aids in the removal of secretions associated with sore mouth
otcwarn: Do not use: For more than 7 days unless told to do so by a doctor. Avoid swallowing. Stop use and ask a doctor if: Sore mouth symptoms do not improve in 7 days. Swelling, rash or fever develops. Irritation, pain or redness persists of worsens.
